digest.component_or_area: LLM capability routing and cache settings
propositions: Capability decisions for native structured output and prompt caching currently use provider-name string prefixes, missing Bedrock-hosted Claude models whose capability flags differ from direct Anthropic API

Two string-matching code paths (output_mode() checking _NATIVE_OUTPUT_PROVIDERS, runner.py checking anthropic prefix) silently degrade for Bedrock Claude by misreading provider name instead of actual capability profile

capabilities_for() must read ModelProfile fields instead of provider strings, accepting both model objects and lazy model strings without importing vendor SDKs, using a _PROFILE_RESOLVERS registry keyed by provider name to resolve capabilities offline

Bedrock-hosted Claude requires a rebar override table that forces native_structured_output=False despite the upstream profile reporting True, preserving the PromptedOutput path that rebar's parse tolerates
Prompt cache settings dispatch on prompt_cache_style field (anthropic/bedrock/none) derived from profile capability fields, not from isinstance checks that would fail in CI due to missing boto3
Supports_thinking field belongs on ModelCapabilities for S5 provenance signing, but output_mode() must not read it so extended thinking remains decoupled from output format constraints
